title: CLARIN-PT-LDB: An Open LLM Leaderboard for Portuguese to assess Language, Culture and Civility

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on a custom question-answering benchmark (Tuguesice-PT) consisting of queries that implicitly assume familiarity with European Portuguese culture, assessing whether models exhibit intrinsic bias by defaulting to other cultural contexts (e.g., Brazilian) due to training data imbalances.

Using the DoNotAnswer-PT benchmark to prompt models with requests that solicit harmful, racist, or discriminatory content, and employing an LLM judge (Llama 3.3 70B Instruct) to classify whether the evaluated model safely refuses the request.
